text:
maria: Anyone seeing high eviction rates in eu-east3? GPU pools showing ~20% preempt rate and a spool of pending pods.
incident-bot: Pager triggered: eu-east3-preemptions (P2). Alert group: gpu-evictions. Link: https://infraclt/alerts/1951234
ken: Confirming. I see node churn and kubelet OOMs starting 03:14 UTC. top metric: eviction_rate=0.21
alex: I rolled the kernel boot patch to a subset at ~02:50 UTC — possible regression. Rolling back now.
ken: Starting cordon/drain on pool-gpu-eu-east3-b (8 nodes). Command:
```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-eu-east3-b-{0..7}
kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data node/gpu-eu-east3-b-{0..7}
```
sre-rotation-bot: oncall handoff scheduled: ken -> alex at 04:10 UTC (in ~55m)
alex: Triggering traffic tilt playbook to offload to eu-west2. Canary 10% -> 40% over 8m. Note: cross-region egress estimated +$120/hr.
maria: Ok to proceed, keep latency SLO target 99p < 150ms. Suppress duplicate pages for 10m to reduce noise: `/incident update-policy eu-east3-preemptions suppress=10m`
incident-bot: Policy update accepted. Duplicate paging suppressed for 10m.
ryan: Observability note: KV cache hit drops with tilt; watch per-model latency on routes /gen and /chat.
ken: Drain complete, 8 nodes cordoned. Pod reschedules to non-preemptible pool where capacity allowed. Replacements provisioning (non-preemptible) underway.
alex: Canary tilt at 40% stable for 6m, error rates steady. Increasing to 70%.
maria: Good. Once traffic at 70% and eviction rate <5% for 15m we start cleanup. I'll open a short postmortem and cost impact note.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated -> monitoring. Closing pager. Last alert id: 1951234567
maria: Thanks team :thumbsup:
